headline: Ecolab (ECL) Could Be 12% Undervalued After Its Dividend Affirmation
summary: Ecolab dividend affirmation and what it means for shareholders Ecolab (ECL) has affirmed a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.73 per share, payable on October 15, 2026, to shareholders of record on September 15, marking 89 consecutive years of cash dividends. See our latest analysis for Ecolab.
